messages:
ops-bot: [P1 ALERT] Inference latency spike detected in eu-west-1. 5xx increase on /v1/generate. Pager sent to @maria. War room: https://zoom.redwood.com/warroom/1789012345
maria: Ack — I'm oncall and joining the war room now. @sanjay can you own customer comms/status page? I'll lead incident ops.
sanjay: Acked. Creating status page draft and customer notification. Draft link: https://docs.redwood.com/drafts/1789012345
sanjay: ```statuspage
Status: Investigating
Impact: Some requests in EU-WEST-1 may fail or be slow. Teams are investigating.
Estimated affected: <5% of requests to /v1/generate
Next update: in 15m
```
eva: Joining warroom. I'll start runbook Step 1: validate kvcache, check batch scheduler and recent deploys. Pulling logs now.
ryan: pausing eu-west routing in load balancer, starting gradual reroute to eu-central. I'll post when done.
maria: war room link for everyone: https://zoom.redwood.com/warroom/1789012345 — oncall ack confirmed :white_check_mark:
sanjay: Draft customer note (short): "We're investigating increased latency and errors for generation requests in EU-WEST-1. We're actively mitigating and will update in 15 minutes." Good to publish when we have confirmation.
ops-bot: Metric snapshot: 5xx rate spiked to 3.8% at 14:02 UTC. Rolling averages show drop to 2.1% after initial mitigation.
eva: Logs show KV cache eviction storm + slow disk IO on node pool. Applying cache throttle and increasing cache shard limit now.
ryan: Reroute to eu-central at 40% complete. Error rate in eu-west trending down, latency 95p improving.
maria: Assigning postmortem owner: eva. Sanjay — please prepare the initial statuspage update and schedule customer email template. I'll handle severity + exec notif.
sanjay: Publishing status update now: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/1789012345 — set to "Investigating". Will update to "Identified" after root cause confirmed.
maria: Thanks team. Keep war room updates short. If we hit regression, page the second-oncall. :thumbsup:
